reason: A browser extension bridge that gives agents tools to inspect and control Chromium tabs, including navigation, DOM interaction, screenshots, and page JavaScript evaluation; human review is warranted because the bridge is unauthenticated on localhost and provides broad browser control.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体连接到 Chromium 浏览器，以读取页面、操作标签页、执行交互并截取屏幕。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Chromium browsers over a local WebSocket for page reading, tab control, interaction, screenshots, and JavaScript evaluation.

capabilities: Connects a DeepSeek Harness agent to a Chromium browser through a localhost WebSocket
Lists, activates, navigates, reloads, and changes browser tabs
Reads visible page content and identifies interactive DOM elements
Clicks elements, types into fields, sends keyboard input, scrolls, and waits for page state
Captures browser screenshots and saves them to a local directory
Evaluates JavaScript expressions in page contexts
Exposes an unauthenticated local WebSocket bridge
